description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we’re here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.

 
 
 StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we’re here to delight them—from the moment they start searching for tickets to the moment they’re walking into the venue.

 At StubHub, we’re not just selling tickets; we’re elevating the entire live event experience. Fans come to us to discover, buy, and sell tickets to the events they love—and our engineers make that experience fast, intuitive, and trustworthy across web and mobile.

 This role is designed for new graduates who want hands-on production experience, strong mentorship, and exposure to modern engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and GenAI tools in a collaborative team environment. You’ll work closely with Senior Engineers and SDE IIs, shipping meaningful features while leveling up quickly.

 Location: Hybrid (3 days in office / 2 days remote) — New York, NY

 About the Team:  

 The Consumer Experience team owns the end-to-end journey for millions of fans discovering, buying, and selling tickets on StubHub’s web and mobile platforms. Every search, recommendation, checkout flow, and confirmation page is built by our teams.

 We operate at global scale, serving fans across 60+ regions and 30+ languages with fast, localized, and reliable experiences during high-demand moments. This is high-impact engineering with real-time traffic spikes and complex distributed systems challenges.

 Our teams are deeply cross-functional, with engineering, product, design, and data working in true partnership and shared ownership. Engineers influence strategy, shape roadmaps, and have direct access to experimentation and insights that guide decisions.

 We build across the full stack, choosing tools and technologies that help us move quickly and deliver quality at scale. We are relentless about understanding fans, using data and rapid iteration to raise the bar on every release.

 If you are excited to build products used by millions, solve meaningful technical challenges, and define the future of live event commerce, we would love to build with you.



 What You'll Do: 

 
 
 Build AI-first consumer product experiences 
 
 Invent and ship new ways for fans to discover and buy tickets using AI-powered product thinking and tooling.

 Prototype quickly, validate ideas with data, and iterate into polished experiences that feel simple and delightful.

 


 Integrate AI into how we build 
 
 Use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, OpenAI) to accelerate the full development lifecycle: brainstorming and design exploration, code generation, test planning, debugging, documentation, and drafting PRs.

 Apply AI to analysis and iteration—summarizing qualitative feedback, spotting patterns in product behavior, and turning insights into concrete improvements.

 


 Deliver features at global scale 
 
 Build and evolve high-traffic web and mobile product surfaces used by millions of fans.

 Contribute to systems and APIs that support personalization, localization, experimentation, and reliable performance across regions.

 


 Learn fast with strong mentorship 
 
 Work closely with experienced engineers who care about clarity, craftsmanship, and setting you up to own features end-to-end.

 


 




 
 What We're Looking for: 



 
 
 Recent graduate or software engineer with up to ~1 year of experience (including internships, co-ops, or substantial academic projects).

 Strong CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and core programming concepts).

 Basic experience building user-facing applications and/or consuming APIs.

 Exposure to LLMs or GenAI tools (coursework, internships, hackathons, or side projects)—bonus if you’ve used frameworks or platforms like Anthropic or ChatGPT in something you built.

 
 Why you’ll love this team: 

 
 Product impact: You’ll ship directly to fans and see your work in the core StubHub experience.

 AI-first culture: We don’t treat AI as a demo—we use it to build better products and to build faster, across ideation, analysis, implementation, and iteration.

 Experimentation mindset: We run tight loops: build → measure → learn → improve.

 Cross-functional collaboration: Engineers partner deeply with product, design, and data to build experiences that are both effective and enjoyable.

 
 What We Offer: 



 
 Accelerated Growth Environment : An environment designed for swift skill and knowledge enhancement, where you have the autonomy to lead experiments and tests on a massive scale.

 Top Tier Compensation Package : Competitive base, equity, and upside that tracks with your impact.

 Flexible Time Of f: Enjoy unlimited Flex Time Off, giving you the flexibility to manage your schedule and take time to recharge as needed.

 Comprehensive Benefits Package : Prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package, featuring 401k, and premium Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance options.

 The anticipated gross base pay range is below for this role. Actual compensation will vary depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and competencies. Base annual salary is one component of StubHub’s total compensation and competitive benefits package, which includes equity, 401(k), paid time off, paid parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits. 

 Salary Range
 $120,000 — $150,000 USD 


 About Us  

 StubHub is the world’s leading marketplace to buy and sell tickets to any live event, anywhere. Through StubHub in North America and viagogo, our international platform, we service customers in 195 countries in 33 languages and 49 available currencies. With more than 300 million tickets available annually on our platform to events around the world -- from sports to music, comedy to dance, festivals to theater -- StubHub offers the safest, most convenient way to buy or sell tickets to the most memorable live experiences. Come join our team for a front-row seat to the action. 

  

 For California Residents: California Job Applicant Privacy Notice found  here 

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity on our team. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
